roles_table: | Builder | Harness, any model (default DeepSeek) | Sizes the team, builds in waves, revises on notes. |
| Independent reviewer | Configurable, any vendor (e.g. Kimi) | Scores 0–10 and lists blocking defects. |
| Client / coordinator | Your MCP client (e.g. Claude) | Sends the brief and reads the result. |
bold_vendor_line: **Using a reviewer from a different vendor means a model never grades its own work.**
